KXNHL30COMEBACK.quote: lose the first three games of a series (going down 0-3), and then win four consecutive games
KXNHL30COMEBACK.reason: YES if any team in the 2026 playoffs wins a series 4-3 after trailing 0-3. This is a path event across all best-of-7 series, driven by per-game win probabilities, home-ice sequence and series length. It shares the series-sequence mechanism of the series-length props, not a single-series winner. It is a league-wide aggregate over up to 15 series, so its fit with the archetype is imperfect.

KXNHL4NATIONS.quote: If the Sweden wins the 4 Nations Face-Off, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNHL4NATIONS.reason: Tournament-winner contract for the 4 Nations Face-Off, a best-on-best tournament run by the NHL and NHLPA with NHL rosters. The structure is a futures winner, like Cup and conference futures. Scope is uncertain: these are national teams, not NHL clubs, and they play outside the NHL season. It is kept in scope at low confidence because the players and organiser are NHL.

KXNHLDRAFTPICK.quote: is selected as the 5th overall pick in the 2026 NHL Draft
KXNHLDRAFTPICK.reason: The rules confirm YES only if the named prospect is selected at an exact overall slot (e.g. 5th) in the 2026 NHL Draft. The outcome comes from lottery-determined order, pick ownership and club selection choices. This matches the draft_selection archetype exactly; the prior title-based guess is now verified.

KXNHLDRAFTTOP.quote: is drafted top 10 in the 2026 NHL Draft
KXNHLDRAFTTOP.reason: The rules confirm YES if the named prospect is drafted within the top N picks (e.g. top 10) of the 2026 NHL Draft, so it is a cumulative draft-slot threshold. The mechanism is draft order plus club selection over a prospect board, which is the draft_selection archetype. Unlike the prior decision, this is now verified from the rules text.

KXNHLNEXTGM.quote: is appointed, elected, named, designated, or succeeded to the position as General Manager for Toronto Maple Leafs before Nov 1, 2026
KXNHLNEXTGM.reason: YES if a named person is appointed Toronto Maple Leafs General Manager before a deadline (Nov 1, 2026). This is an organisational personnel decision by the club, not on-ice performance. It fits offfield_markets (transactions and announcements in the organisation), and both the deadline and the candidate are explicit in the rules.

KXNHLOVERTIME.quote: If Carolina and Vegas go to overtime in the Carolina vs Vegas professional hockey game
KXNHLOVERTIME.reason: YES if a single game, identified as the game originally scheduled for its date, goes to overtime, i.e. it is tied after regulation. This is the overtime-occurrence event in game_events, decided by regulation goal differential being zero. The 'originally scheduled' wording ties settlement to that fixture if it is postponed.

KXNHLPLAYOFFGOALS.quote: which player records the most goals in the Stanley Cup Finals
KXNHLPLAYOFFGOALS.reason: This is a stat-leader race: the most goals by a player within one playoff round (e.g. the Stanley Cup Final). Ties pay dead-heat $1/N, and a player who does not enter any game in the round resolves to a fair price. It is the same leader-race mechanism as the Richard/Ross leaders in season_awards_and_stats, but over a short, variable-length window, which makes it noisier. Confidence is medium because the round window and the dead-heat rule differ from season leaders.

KXNHLRETIRE.quote: announces his retirement from the NHL before the 2026-27 NHL season start date
KXNHLRETIRE.reason: YES if the named player announces an NHL retirement, effective immediately or before the next season, before the 2026-27 season starts. This is a personal and organisational announcement, not game performance. It fits offfield_markets (announcements and transactions outside the game).

KXNHLSERIES.quote: win the Montreal Canadiens vs Buffalo Sabres 2nd Round series in the 2026 NHL playoffs
KXNHLSERIES.reason: YES if the named team wins a specific best-of-7 playoff series (e.g. 2nd Round MTL vs BUF). The rules confirm this is a series-winner future, which is explicitly within the season_futures target (wins a playoff series). It is not a single-game moneyline as the ledger filed it.

KXNHLSERIESGAMES.quote: If above 6.5 games are played in the Vegas Golden Knights vs Carolina Hurricanes Stanley Cup series
KXNHLSERIESGAMES.reason: Over/under on the number of games played in one best-of-7 series (strike 6.5). The quantity is series length, set by the compounded per-game win probabilities and the home-ice sequence. This is the series-length prop that playoff_series_aggregate declares.

KXNHLSERIESSCORE.quote: If the series score is Vegas Golden Knights wins 4-3
KXNHLSERIESSCORE.reason: YES if the series ends with an exact score (e.g. VGK 4-3). This is the joint distribution of series winner and length from the per-game win-probability sequence. It covers more than season_futures (winner only) and is the exact-score sibling explicitly named for playoff_series_aggregate.

KXNHLSERIESSPREAD.quote: wins by more than 2.5 games in the Vegas Golden Knights vs Carolina Hurricanes Stanley Cup series
KXNHLSERIESSPREAD.reason: Series game spread: YES if the named team wins the series by more than 2.5 games, which means 4-0 or 4-1. The outcome is a function of the winner and series length jointly, from the same best-of-7 sequence model. It belongs in playoff_series_aggregate, not in single-game puck lines.

KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOAL.quote: collectively score at least 50 goals, then the market resolves to Yes
KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOAL.reason: YES if both teams together score at least N goals (e.g. 50+) across all games of one playoff series. The total is summed over a random 4-7 game length, so it depends jointly on series length and per-game scoring. The rules confirm the prior playoff_series_aggregate decision. Whether OT goals count is not stated, but playoff OT is played to a sudden-death goal.
